actions.oldValue: Head to the Old Vic to experience one of Tom Stoppard's most famous plays, The Real Thing, in an exciting new revival. Together, the ensemble tells the story of Henry, a married playwright, and Annie, an actress, who fall in love. Through layers of fact and fiction and a play within the play, the show explores themes of reality versus appearance, love, and infidelity.
